title: Experiment 5 topology decision artifact (chi output)
description: Typed, externally inspectable decision object. chi(T,E,K) -> {CREATE, DO_NOT_CREATE}. CREATE means: an isolated descendant can provide material evidence or decomposition value that cannot be obtained as effectively under the current local topology, and the expected value exceeds the bounded cost. DO_NOT_CREATE means: the task can be resolved adequately within the current topology and descendant creation would add negligible or unjustified value. Neither decision is about task difficulty. Hidden reasoning is not evidence: only the concise reasons in this artifact count.

conditional_constraints.CREATE: unresolved_distinctions must be non-empty; expected_child_contribution must be non-empty and every distinction_id must reference a listed unresolved distinction id. A CREATE lacking these is INVALID_CREATION_DECISION.
conditional_constraints.DO_NOT_CREATE: local_resolution_path must be non-empty; expected_child_contribution must be empty.
